title: Just hit a wild milestone with our trading group (3400% in 150 days) – looking to connect with a few fellow traders
author: Silly_Fill_1483
selftext:
​Hey guys,

​I help manage a small, private English-speaking trading community and we just crossed a pretty crazy milestone today, so I wanted to share it here and hopefully connect with some like-minded people.

​We’ve been tracking and mirroring a specific strategy for the last 150 trading days. The stats just updated and the main account is officially up 3,400% over that period, with a track record of 1,424 wins and only 190 losses. What’s even cooler is seeing the community growth—the members copying these setups have locked in over $400k in collective profit so far.

​We’re looking to bring a few more active, serious members into the group to keep the momentum going and have more quality discussion in the chat.

​It’s completely free, we just want to keep the vibe high-quality and filter out the noise. If you're trading actively and want to check out the stats or jump in, just drop me a DM and I’ll send you the details.

​Cheers!
